title: run
description: Execute an intent as a planned-and-verified RACT run.
rationale: Canonical execute-an-intent verb; every downstream flag applies.

title: skills
description: List and inspect builtin and installed skills.
rationale: Skill registry surface exposed to operators.

title: mcp
description: Manage and invoke MCP tools registered with RACT.
rationale: MCP adapter surface for external tool servers.

title: retrieval
description: Query the retrieval adapter over the current workspace.

title: diff
description: Show and apply RACT-authored diffs against the workspace.

title: explain
description: Explain a plan, step, or artifact with its provenance chain.

title: report
description: Render run reports in markdown or HTML.

title: handshakes
description: List, approve, reject, defer, or review pending operator handshakes.

title: refactor
description: Run a scoped refactor over a named target.

title: rename
description: Rename a symbol project-wide through the symbol renamer.

title: docs
description: Generate or regenerate documentation for the workspace.

title: init
description: Initialize a new RACT project from a template.

title: openapi
description: Generate an OpenAPI client or server scaffold.

title: plan
description: Load, save, or replay a serialized plan.

title: doctor
description: Diagnose RACT installation, config, and workspace state.

title: audit
description: Audit a workspace or run for anti-rot and provenance issues.

title: load-bearing
description: Inspect or manage load-bearing annotations across the workspace.

title: novelty
description: Report novelty budget usage and scan for overruns.

title: coverage
description: Report coverage deltas and status.

title: quality
description: Compute the plan quality scorecard.

title: mutation
description: Run the mutation test suite and report kill counts.

title: whisper
description: Run the Legacy Whisperer over a target module.

title: auction
description: Run the Dead Code Auction sweep and inspect proposals.

title: fence
description: Enforce or inspect Chesterton's Fence records over the workspace.

title: marketplace
description: Browse and install skills from the skills marketplace.

title: consolidate
description: Scan, apply, or rollback consolidation proposals over the workspace.

title: release
description: Prepare and publish a GitHub release for the current tag.

title: merge-gate
description: Evaluate the merge gate over pending changes.

title: rot-report
description: Render the anti-rot report.

title: receipt-export
description: Export a bundle of signed receipts for downstream verification.

title: rot
description: Run anti-rot scans and inspect results.

title: operator-queue
description: Inspect the operator queue of pending requests.

title: receipt
description: Load, verify, or inspect a signed receipt or receipt chain.

title: policy-gate
description: Evaluate the policy gate against pending changes.

title: run-fingerprint
description: Compute or diff run fingerprints for reproducibility checks.

title: ai-sbom
description: Emit an AI-SBOM for the current run.

title: calibrate
description: Run the experimental calibration harness.

title: infer
description: Run the experimental inference harness.

title: repro-manifest
description: Emit an experimental reproducibility manifest.

title: config
description: Inspect, diff, or validate the ract.yaml configuration.

title: provider
description: Inspect provider presets and routing.

title: cost
description: Report cost accumulation across a run or session.

title: router
description: Inspect provider router state and complexity routing.

title: self-audit
description: Run RACT's self-audit checks over its own installation.

title: status
description: Report current session status and outstanding blockers.

title: leaderboard
description: Render the public leaderboard rollup.

title: session
description: List, resume, rollback, or inspect saved sessions.

title: conformance
description: Run the closed-action-union conformance suite (ADR-0014).

title: trace
description: Inspect the hash-chained event log for a run (ADR-0015).

title: provenance
description: Inspect and verify Rootknot-signed provenance sidecars.

title: source-digest
description: Compute or lock the source-tree golden hash over src/ract.
rationale: Golden hash lock surface; see src/ract/source_digest.py.

title: authorship as identity invariant
description: Embedding operator names in module source as a load-bearing identity marker.
rationale: Identity attestation is decoupled from author names; the module-knot registry (src/ract/core/module_identity.py) provides load-time attestation without coupling module identity to any person's name.

title: operator-machine training pipeline
description: Training a first-party model inside the RACT toolchain from operator interaction traces.
rationale: Out of scope; RACT is a claim-and-verify agentic coding tool, not a model-training platform.

title: declarative script-first workflow layer
description: A YAML- or DSL-driven workflow engine that replaces the plan-and-execute loop.
rationale: Plans stay first-class; workflow-DSL would obscure assumption, confidence, and provenance which are the load-bearing invariants.

title: package-registry publish without handshake
description: Publishing to PyPI, npm, or crates.io from a RACT run without an operator-signed handshake.
rationale: Refused by ADR-0007 threat model; requires --allow-tier-3 and an operator handshake.

title: workspace escape
description: Writing or modifying files outside the configured workspace root.
rationale: Refused by ADR-0007 threat model; sandbox refuses at the executor boundary.

title: bulk workspace exfiltration
description: Sending the full workspace to a remote provider in a single request above the chunk threshold.
rationale: Refused by ADR-0007 threat model; default 1 MiB chunk threshold prevents whole-tree upload.

title: sensitive-file read
description: Reading credential files like .env, *.pem, id_rsa, or ~/.ssh/** during a run.
rationale: Refused by ADR-0007 threat model; path patterns denied at the executor boundary.

title: model as done-decider
description: Letting the management LM choose the moment to stop iterating and mark a milestone complete.
rationale: Refused by v0.4.0 SUBSTRATE + ALM; the environment (not the model) evaluates predicates against the final snapshot before 'done' is spoken.

title: manifest
description: v0.1.2-era alias for repro-manifest; emits an experimental reproducibility manifest.
rationale: CHANGELOG 0.1.2 named this verb explicitly; the alias restores the historical surface.

title: memory
description: Manage the memory substrate: three indexes (symbol / graph / semantic), retrieve primitive, four function contracts (intake / research / plan / edit), and three self-adjustment probes (needle / coherence / adherence).
rationale: Memory Discipline module_09 landed the memory substrate CLI surface (v0.5.0); this entry pairs the top-level `memory` verb with its dispatch subverbs (`memory init`, `memory apply-narrowings`).
